snippet.title: Confidential Killings - A Detective Game, Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the latest trailer for Confidential Killings - A Detective Game, a gritty thriller set in Hollywood’s twisted world of stars from developers BRANE and Lorenzo Boni, as well as publisher Surefire.Games, available NOW on Steam.

Use expert deduction skills to interrogate witnesses and suspects, decipher clues, spot inconsistencies, and connect the dots between a series of seemingly unrelated murders. Analyze the evidence and add elements to a string board to make connections and progress the narrative. Enjoy a striking noir art style paired with a dark, thematic soundtrack while unraveling the conspiracy in 1970s Hollywood.

Play and wishlist the game on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797960/Confidential_Killings__A_Detective_Game/

Join the community on the Discord here:
https://discord.gg/xwFXgbb2xf
